{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'].str.lower() == 'loyal') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Verify no QA orders are present (should be 0)
qa_check = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Rows in loyal_completed: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'QA orders in loyal_completed: {len(qa_check)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
